# SonarCloud Tool

## Purpose
SonarCloud provides continuous code quality analysis integrated with GitHub PRs.
It uses the JaCoCo XML report for coverage data.

## Configuration
| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Project Key | umdc-commons-services |
| Organization | umdevc |
| JaCoCo report path | target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml |
| CI trigger | push/PR to main, develop, master |

## CI Command (from .github/workflows/build.yml)
```bash
mvn -B verify org.sonarsource.scanner.maven:sonar-maven-plugin:sonar \
    -Dsonar.projectKey=umdc-commons-services
```

## Required Environment Variables (CI secrets)
- GITHUB_TOKEN -- automatic in GitHub Actions
- SONAR_TOKEN  -- set as GitHub Actions secret

## Notes
- SonarCloud analysis runs automatically on push/PR via .github/workflows/build.yml
- Coverage is sourced from target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml (generated by mvn verify)
- Never set SONAR_TOKEN in committed files
